ChatSession.title: Chat Session
ChatSession.description: Represents a chat conversation between a user and the site owner.

id.description: The session ID (usually the user's anonymous ID or UID)

lastMessage.description: The content of the last message sent

unreadCount.description: Number of unread messages for the admin

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A single message within a chat session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the parent chat session

isAdmin.description: Whether the message was sent by the admin

/chat_sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{mes.description: Sub-collection of messages for a specific session.
